cues: Sit with hips against the pad and the roller just above the ankles.
Extend both knees smoothly while gripping the handles.
Continue raising the shins with hips and thighs stable.
Straighten the knees without snapping into lockout and squeeze your quads.
Lower the shins through mid-range under control.
Continue returning toward the bent-knee start without dropping the load.
reuseReason: Return passes same knee positions with controlled lowering cues.
mechanicsFailure: Fixed machine axle changes position between poses; apparent rigid lever geometry varies.
